name: Stage an operator review request under /tmp

data.command: printf '%s\n' 'operator review request pending manual review' > /tmp/operator-review-request.txt && shasum -a 256 /tmp/operator-review-request.txt && echo 'request staged in /tmp'

submissions.reason: Write an operator review request under /tmp with checksum.

cleanup.reason: Remove the operator review ticket from /tmp.
